name: IDPH End Stage Renal Disease Facility Directory

columns.name: Facility Name
columns.description: Legal name of the licensed ESRD treatment facility as registered with HFSRB. May include the corporate parent's name followed by " - DBA " and the public-facing name; use the DBA Name column for the trade name only.

columns.name: Address
columns.description: Street address of the facility's licensed location, including suite or unit number where applicable.

columns.name: City
columns.description: City in which the facility is physically located.

columns.name: County
columns.description: Illinois county in which the facility is physically located.

columns.name: Zip
columns.description: 5-digit U.S. Postal Service ZIP code of the facility's address. Stored as text to preserve any leading zeros.

columns.name: Contact Name
columns.description: Name of the facility's primary administrative or licensing contact on file with HFSRB.

columns.name: Phone
columns.description: Primary telephone number for the facility, in (XXX) XXX-XXXX format.

columns.name: Medicare Number
columns.description: HFSRB facility identifier in the format 14-XXXX, where 14 is the Illinois state prefix. This is not the full CMS Certification Number (CCN); to derive the CCN, concatenate "14" with the four-digit suffix (e.g., 14-2867 → CCN 142867).
